items.headline: $MORPHO Drama: AI Tool Posts 'Broken Model' Rant
items.summary: Morpho blamed an AI marketing tool for a deleted X post calling its curator business model unsustainable. $AAVE founder Stani Kulechov dubbed it the most bearish take for $MORPHO holders.

items.headline: $ME Legacy Approvals Exploited, $5.7M in NFTs Rescued
items.summary: Legacy Magic Eden approvals left $5.7M in NFTs exposed to an exploit before white hats stepped in to rescue the assets. Users with old $ME marketplace approvals should revoke them now.

items.headline: $AAVE V4 on Base Adds Tokenized Stocks as Collateral
items.summary: Aave V4 on Base now accepts Coinbase tokenized stocks as collateral for USDC loans, a fresh DeFi use case bridging equities and onchain borrowing. Big unlock for $AAVE's RWA push.

items.headline: $SOL Alpenglow Upgrade Hits Devnet, Mainnet Next
items.summary: Solana's Alpenglow consensus upgrade is live on devnet, moving validator voting off-chain for ~150ms settlement. Anza is urging devs to test ahead of the $SOL mainnet migration.

items.headline: Kalshi Loses Appeal in Ohio, Tennessee Betting Fight
items.summary: A federal appeals court ruled Kalshi hasn't shown its sports event contracts are swaps under the Commodity Exchange Act, widening a circuit split with big implications for prediction markets.
